name: Wiki Page History
description: Every wiki page with its saved revisions and the administrator's deletes over time, the pages in the time range listed by their revisions, usernames and deletes, and one page's history in the side panel: who wrote on it when, and each revision as what it added or removed against the one before, by username and IP prefix, with the deletes in place.

records.name: revision
records.one: one saved revision of a page, or one delete of it

fields.name: kind
fields.from: a line of revisions.jsonl, or event_type delete

fields.name: user
fields.how: as written, an empty label as no username

fields.name: before
fields.from: the page's revisions and deletes in time order
fields.how: the text of the revision before, empty for the first stored one and after a delete

fields.name: after
fields.from: the page's revisions and deletes in time order
fields.how: restored when the first save after a delete has the text from before it, else re-created

records.name: page
records.one: one wiki page with its revisions and deletes

fields.name: key
fields.from: page_key of pages.jsonl, revisions.jsonl or a delete
fields.how: a page with no line in pages.jsonl named by its delete

accepts.means: line <n> of revisions.jsonl or events.jsonl: the revision or delete in its page's history in the side panel; of pages.jsonl: that page's history; of labels.jsonl: the pages with records by that username; a request of events.jsonl, which names no page, alone in the side panel

units.means: one page's whole history, such as dse~StartSeite
the pages with records by one username, listed
